question: Will Freddie Mac’s average 30-year US mortgage rate fall below 7.18% in the survey released Thu 12 Nov 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Freddie Mac’s Primary Mortgage Market Survey released on 2026-11-12 (or earlier that week, if moved for a holiday) reports a 30-year fixed-rate average strictly below 7.18% (the 2026-11-05 figure).
- "No": That rate is 7.18% or higher.

Clarifications:
- Use the 30-year fixed-rate average, not the 15-year rate.
